'''Mal Khestekk''' was an upstart crime boss who sought to rise through the ranks of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cartao/Legends|Cartao's]] underworld during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|The New Boss}}</ref>
